semantic_gate.ssim_definition: skimage.metrics.structural_similarity per frame, data_range=255, channel_axis=-1; arithmetic mean by view over frames at or after decoder support

requirements: predicted representative exact hash differs from actual 12-frame hash
target plus four continuation blocks exists
span distinct intent and camera/movement state groups
held_out_selection.selection_order: greedily maximize new intent token and movement/camera group; SHA256 rank breaks ties, then fills remaining slots

confidence_gate.confidence: top intent transition count divided by context count with deterministic longest-context backoff
confidence_gate.candidate_thresholds: all unique train cross-fit confidence values plus a reject-all sentinel
confidence_gate.precision_lower_bound: one-sided 95% Wilson score lower bound, z=1.6448536269514722
confidence_gate.objective: maximize train cross-fit expected net saved milliseconds among thresholds whose intent precision lower bound exceeds measured break-even precision
